scope: One historical frozen C8. Eight own-start TTFTs; evaluate the maximum again after changing each request. For each layer take the optimistic TP slowest-rank budget on each DP and most favorable allowed EP16 entry skew. All other work and scheduling are fixed. Uniform fractions apply to the existing HcPre only; new Y, synchronization and deferred coefficient contention still cost time.
decision: Use the resulting residual-time budget for ordinary FFNPost→Attention HcPre early Y with all later readers intact. Smaller branch-only proposals need a change to a wider region to cross this guide.
limits: A modeled necessary condition under fixed timing assumptions. Neither a runnable implementation nor a general bound on a reformulated protocol or a deployment probability.
All six scenarios overlap and cannot be added. Model timing drift and changes to DP admission are outside this replay.

first_reader_native.scope: Matched synthetic activations, actual layer 1/2 checkpoint weights, archived CP token row ranges and simultaneous TP8s. Max rank per group per round precedes differencing. The 34 ordinary layers reuse same-shape native costs. The eight request maxima are recomputed after per-original-EP-barrier credit with bounded DP skew. Replacement coefficients that miss the original post deadline are charged; real interference with remaining Attention is unmeasured.
limits: Native nine device clocks/outputs do not prove service latency. Host scheduling and inter-rank arrival during eager submission can dominate measurements. Local/gather records the gather wait as observed by the caller, not a separate HCCL completion event.
Per-layer multiplication is a conditional schedule model with shared-cost samples; 34 layers are not independent repetitions. Cache pressure is a 224 MiB touch, not measured evicted hardware bytes.

isolated_Q_bound.scope: Fully hide local BF16 Wq_a during unchanged all-gather; group joins and other work, launch gaps, memory traffic and contention fixed. Use the maximum eligible archived kernel duration on either DP every layer; overlapping eight TP ranks are never added. KV-only and empty ranks receive zero credit. Recompute the maximum of all eight original request latencies.
isolated_Q_bound.decision: Deprioritize a separate service campaign for pure Q compute overlap at this workload if below the gate. Joint residual/Y and changes to launch gaps, contention or other readers have a larger scope.
